governance.residuals_note: DETERMINATION NOT-YET, fully scored. Structural WINS vs nyiso-66-resync-base: C1 fuel-mix now PASS all years (the corrected outages lower over-forced downstate ST_GAS must-run, freeing CC_REGULAR back into band: 2023 -3.76->-2.35 TWh, 2024 -2.94->-1.57, 2025 -1.12->+0.43); C2 sysvol PASS; C4 dispatch r PASS; C7 shape PASS; C8 forced-share PASS. Remaining blockers are ALL 2023 and ALL reserve-driven: C3a mean +17.8%, C3b shape NRMSE 0.215, C3c tail 31h vs RT 10h. Diagnosed (system_2023 hourly): every one of the 57 >$300 zone-hours is downstate (Long_Island + NYC), summer (Jul-Sep), reserve-price-driven (54/57 have reserve_price>$50, price<->reserve r=0.79) with ZERO unserved energy (no slack). The corrected (physically-real) outages thin downstate thermal reserve headroom in tight summer hours, and the energy+reserve co-opt is thermal+storage-only — it lacks NYISO's real downstate/East-region hydro + pumped-storage (Blenheim-Gilboa) 10-min reserve supply and SCR/EDRP 30-min operating-reserve supply, so the East-10min/SENY-30min ORDC shadow price spikes and flows into the LBMP. This is issue #1344 (NYISO reserve/scarcity price formation), exposed — not caused — by the now-correct supply. Per CLAUDE.md rule 1/11 the correct measured mechanisms STAY IN even though 2023 fit regressed; reverting to the stale outages to keep C3a passing (nyiso-66's only reason it passed) is precisely what rule 1 forbids. The named root-cause fix is lever #3 (see _open_items), NOT a residual tune.

_open_items: (1) LOAD-BEARING ROOT CAUSE — NYISO downstate reserve/scarcity price formation (issue #1344). The 2023 C3a/C3b/C3c misses are entirely reserve-driven downstate summer scarcity (57 zone-hours, all LI+NYC, Jul-Sep, reserve_price-correlated r=0.79, zero unserved energy). The energy+reserve co-opt is thermal+storage-only. FIX (lever #3, structurally grounded, rule 1): give NYISO's East-region hydro + pumped-storage (Blenheim-Gilboa ~1160 MW) 10-min reserve eligibility (CAISO precedent reserve_config._caiso_reserve_eligible), and/or make the SCR/EDRP blocks 30-min operating-reserve eligible (real SCRs are 30-min OR resources) so they relieve the SENY-30min requirement as well as clearing energy. Blocker today: the NYISO dispatch fleet carries NO hydro/PS units (Blenheim-Gilboa is absent; hydro is a monthly-energy resource), so this needs the PS unit ADDED to the fleet first — a separate structural workstream, not a residual tune. (2) The corrected outage extract + DR lever are RESTORED and committed (the nyiso-66 _open_items (1) is closed). C1 fuel-mix now PASS. (3) The offer_curve_by_group re-tune remains deliberately NOT taken (rule 22): the 2023 hole is reserve price formation, not a CC/ST offer-curve markup, so tuning curves to it would be fitting to the residual.

entries.name: nyiso_scr_edrp
entries.note: NYISO SCR/EDRP emergency demand response as endogenous per-zone price-responsive supply blocks. Capacity = Gold-Book-registered SCR+EDRP MW per model zone (2023/24/25 summer 1.23/1.29/1.49 GW, scripts/data/build_nyiso_scr_edrp.py, byte-identical to the transcribed enrollment CSV). Strike = the published NYISO EDRP $500/MWh compensation floor (Market Services Tariff §5.12) — a market-design constant, NOT a residual. Clears the energy balance only when the zone LBMP exceeds the strike (endogenous scarcity trigger, never pinned to observed event dates; rule 13/17). ZERO fitted values; re-derives for a forward year from the next Gold Book (rule 23). Excluded from generation-mix scoring (avoided load, not generation).
